company.name: Kayrros
company.shortDescription: Kayrros is an advanced data analytics company that helps global energy market participants make better investment decisions.
company.description: Kayrros is the leading advanced data analytics company that helps global energy market players make better investment decisions. Kayrros experts extract value from the integration of alternative and market data into unique product offerings across the energy chain. With more than 100 employees representing over 15 nationalities working from headquarters in Paris and offices in Houston, London, New York and Singapore, Kayrros delivers actionable information in near real-time using cutting-edge technologies. Kayrros solutions are rapidly scalable and continually expanded to new geographies and new sources of data that help provide greater transparency into energy markets worldwide.

aiResearchSummary.text: Kayrros is researching computer implemented methods and systems for detecting heat emission sources in nighttime satellite data, automated detection and quantification of gas emissions from satellite images, and assessment of wildfire risk for a given geographical area. It also develops methods and systems for stockpile monitoring using synthetic aperture radar and for monitoring floods and rights of way, integrating remote sensing, image reconstruction and multi source geospatial analytics across these areas of research and development.
